title: PRF Security of Reduced-Round DbHtF MACs
summary: Four-round DbHtF-style MACs with truncated permutation-based Luby–Rackoff output achieve PRF security; whether variants with fewer rounds do so remains open.

formal_statement.body: The four-round $\mathrm{DbHtF}$-style message-authentication-code construction truncates the output of a permutation-based Luby--Rackoff construction and achieves $\mathrm{PRF}$ security. Determine whether $\mathrm{DbHtF}$-style message-authentication-code constructions using fewer than four permutation-based Luby--Rackoff rounds also achieve $\mathrm{PRF}$ security.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography, specifically PRF security of DbHtF-style message-authentication codes built from permutation-based Luby–Rackoff constructions.
parameters: Round count: four rounds in the established construction and fewer than four in the unresolved variants
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether DbHtF-style message-authentication-code constructions using fewer than four permutation-based Luby–Rackoff rounds achieve PRF security.

progress.summary: The source presents the four-round construction as PRF-secure and explicitly leaves the security of analogous constructions with fewer than four Luby–Rackoff rounds open.
citation_labels: Bishwajit Chakraborty et al., Tweakable Permutation-based Luby-Rackoff Constructions
